invariants.name: draw_calls_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: A painted UI+shader-node frame must issue at least one real draw. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: gpu_upload_bytes_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: Count only after a host encodes/submits. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be treated as 0.

notes: NanaUI-internal GPU scale row; not Issue #8 DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog. Same tree as gpu-scene-shader-nodes-256 but every GpuView node claims its own slot_id, so the scene carries 256 distinct CustomRenderNode::resource strings. The delta against the shared-slot row isolates the render-graph build cost (frame_graph pass and resource count), which is paid on every structural change.
